_about: Sourced paragliding glossary (EN -> DE/FR/ES/ZH-Hans) for the paragliding Atlas translation pipeline. Built 2026-11-17. Every non-placeholder entry was checked: the source was downloaded and the quote string was found verbatim in its extracted text. 'term' is the main rendering; 'also' lists variants, each found on that same page unless noted. 'source_type' says how authoritative the source is: federation sources first (DHV, SHV/FSVL, RFAE/FECDA); press, university, regional-association and Wikipedia sources are secondary and marked as such. ffvl.fr (Cloudflare) and the ASFC/中国航空运动协会 sites were unreachable, so French leans on Swiss FSVL texts and Chinese on secondary sources. '[to supply]' = no checkable source found; do not machine-guess these.
